name: Tanner Sterling
source:
Tanner Sterling is the heir to the Sterling family, the son of Pierce and Margaret Sterling, and the older brother of [url=/c134991/]Bryce Sterling[/url]. To the dismay of his family, Tanner is engaged to [url=/c134904/]Kate O'Malley[/url], whom the rest of his family suspects is a gold digger given her working class roots. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 1.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Tanner_Sterling]Wiki[/url]]
